story.title: Built on Trust
story.content:
With over 15 years of experience in the home improvement industry, Tailored Solutions has built a reputation for excellence across Greater London and the surrounding areas. Our team of skilled craftsmen brings together expertise in electrical work, carpentry, and general renovations to deliver comprehensive solutions for your home.

We believe in doing things right the first time. Every project we undertake is completed to the highest standards, fully compliant with all relevant regulations, and backed by our satisfaction guarantee.

testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell
testimonials.text: Absolutely fantastic service from start to finish. They rewired our entire Victorian terrace and the work was impeccable. Very professional team who kept us informed throughout.

testimonials.name: James Thompson
testimonials.text: The fitted wardrobes they built are stunning. Perfect craftsmanship and attention to detail. They even helped with the design to maximize our awkward alcove space.

testimonials.name: Emma & David Chen
testimonials.text: Our kitchen renovation exceeded all expectations. The team managed everything brilliantly and the finished result is like something from a magazine. Highly recommend!

testimonials.name: Robert Williams
testimonials.text: Had a consumer unit upgrade and additional sockets installed. Quick, clean work and all certified properly. Will definitely use again.

testimonials.name: Lisa Anderson
testimonials.text: Garage conversion into a home office was completed on time and on budget. The attention to detail was exceptional. Love my new workspace!
